items.title: Alice Zeno Interview, 1960-01-25
items.q: It's not so long that I gave a young man, Villery. He had a box somewhat like that. And I was at the home.

ctx.x: Well, next time I come, I'll bring some, the words of quite a few old French songs. And I'll, well, give you a few of them to refresh your memory. Probably if you get a little bit of them, you'll remember more.
It's not so long that I gave a young man, Villery. He had a box somewhat like that. And I was at the home. A la Sive des Vieillards, you know, old folks home.
